Rahul Saraswat    

rahulsaraswatr31@gmail.com | +91 7535929083 | LinkedIn   

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY    

Power Platform & RPA (Power Automate) Developer with 3+ years of industry experience in delivering endtoend business automation solutions. Strong hands-on expertise in Power Automate Cloud Flows for approvals, integrations, and scheduled workflows, along with Power Automate Desktop (RPA) for UI-based task automation. Experienced in Power Apps (Canvas Apps), Dataverse, and enterprise integrations, consistently achieving up to 70% reduction in manual effort. Adept at working in Agile teams, gathering requirements, and deploying scalable, governed automation in production environments.    

CORE SKILLS    

Power Platform: Power Automate (Cloud Flows, Desktop Flows – RPA), Power Apps (Canvas Apps),    Dataverse, Power BI, AI Builder, Microsoft Copilot Studio    

RPA: Power Automate Desktop (UI automation, selectors, error handling, scheduling), UiPath (Basic exposure)    

Integration & Cloud: REST APIs, Azure Functions, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SQL Server, Graph API.    

Programming & Scripting: C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, VB.NET    

Practices: Low-Code/No-Code Automation, Governance, DLP, Exception Handling, Agile/Scrum, Git    

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE    

Accenture Solutions, Noida — Software Analyst (Dec 2023 – Present)    

Designed and implemented scalable Power Automate cloud flows for approvals, notifications, and data synchronization across SharePoint, SQL Server, and Outlook.

Developed RPA solutions using Power Automate Desktop to automate manual UI-driven processes, reducing operational effort by up to 70%.

Built Canvas Apps to enable business users to trigger workflows and track process status.

Implemented robust error handling, logging, and monitoring to support production-grade automations.

Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements, perform UAT, and deploy solutions following governance and security best practices.

Accenture Solutions, Noida — Associate Software Engineer (Oct 2022 – Dec 2023)    

Delivered end-to-end automation solutions using Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop) for reporting and data processing use cases.

Experience with Model-driven Power Apps architecture and Dataverse security concepts.

Automated recurring reports and file handling workflows using Excel, OneDrive, and SharePoint integrations.

Created reusable automation components, improving development efficiency and maintainability.

Provided post-deployment support, enhancements, and performance optimization for existing automations.

PROJECTS     

Enterprise Request & Approval Management System o Designed and developed an enterprise-level request and approval management system using Power Apps (Canvas) and Microsoft Dataverse. o Implemented multi-level approval worktlows using Power Automate with audit logs and automated notifications. o Integrated the solution with SharePoint Online, Outlook, and Microsoft Teams. o Designed Dataverse tables, relationships, and business rules. o Applied Power Platform governance standards and DLP policies. 

Reduced approval turnaround time by 50-60%

Legacy Application Automation (Enterprise RPA) o Automated legacy desktop and web applications using Power Automate Desktop. o Built production-grade RPA solutions with stable 



selectors, retries, exception handling, and execution logging. o Scheduled unattended bots and monitored execution using Power Automate cloud flows. o Integrated automation with SQL Server, Excel, and SharePoint Online. 

Achieved up to 70% reduction in manual operational effort.

CERTIFICATIONS    

PL-200: Microsoft Certified – Power Platform Functional Consultant

PL-400: Microsoft Certified – Power Platform Developer Associate

PL-600: Microsoft Certified – Power Platform Solution Architect Expert

PL-900: Microsoft Certified – Power Platform Fundamentals

PL-500: Microsoft Certified – Power Automate RPA Developer Associate

AI-102: Microsoft Certified – Azure AI Engineer Associate

AI-900: Microsoft Certified – Azure AI Fundamentals

AZ-900: Microsoft Certified – Azure Fundamentals

EDUCATION    

B.Tech – Computer Science & Engineering, GLA University (2018 – 2022)
